menu.cloudSyncDesc: Sign in to backup and sync your Khata across all devices.

install.installAppDesc: Install Khata on your phone or PC for full offline access and fast home screen launch.
install.installGuideIOSStep1: 1. Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari
install.installGuideIOSStep2: 2. Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
install.installGuideAndroid: Tap "Install" below to add Khata to your home screen.
install.installGuideAndroidTip: In Chrome / Edge: Click the 3 dots menu → "Install Khata" or "Add to Home Screen".

home.emptyBody: A notebook keeps track of money you give or take with people — like a shop's daily cash ledger.

notebook.emptyBody: Tap Gave or Got below to add your first entry.

sheet.noteMax: Note can be up to {max} characters

history.title: History
history.emptyBody: Go to Home to open a notebook and add your first entry.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyNote: All your data stays completely private on your device in your browser. No account required, no tracking, and fully functional without an internet connection.

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.importWarning: This will add data from the backup file. Existing data won't be deleted.
backup.replaceWarning: This will replace the current Khata data on this device. Continue?
backup.errInvalidJson: Couldn't read that file — it's not valid JSON.
backup.errInvalidFormat: This doesn't look like a Khata backup file.
backup.errUnsupportedVersion: This backup was made by a newer version of Khata and can't be restored here.
backup.errInvalidData: This backup file is damaged or incomplete and was not restored.
backup.errRestoreFailed: Couldn't restore — your current data was left untouched.
